date_note: Date is Kaunet's second report as relayed by the 24 November article; the article says the unauthorized access to KARTE was on 13 November.
title: Kaunet: 30万525件 records leaked in PLAID KARTE breach, second report says
summary: Cybersecurity.com (Japan) reports that Kaunet's second report on 24 November put the leaked information at 30万525件 records after removing duplicates, following unauthorized access to PLAID's KARTE service on 13 November. The data includes email addresses, customer numbers and phone numbers; Kaunet says card numbers and login passwords were not affected. The article says the incident occurred at the external service, not in Kaunet's own systems.
plain: Kaunet says 30万525件 records leaked from its marketing vendor PLAID's KARTE service. Emails, customer numbers and phone numbers are involved; card numbers and passwords are not.
exec: A vendor's marketing tool breach exposed 30万525件 Kaunet records, per Kaunet's second report.
action: Kaunet warns users about suspicious emails and says it will never ask for passwords or card details by email.

evidence.quote: 漏えいした情報は重複を除いて30万525件だったと発表した。
